The same session as encodings.txt with a client that counts in UTF-16
code units, as every client can: the finding is six columns further left,
and the change that mends it is sent in those columns.

-- lib/dgdtools.yml --
-- lib/obj/a.c --
void f() { /* blåbær € 😀 */ a == 1; }
-- script --
initialize lib
open lib/obj/a.c
diagnostics lib/obj/a.c
change lib/obj/a.c 0:31-0:33 "="
text lib/obj/a.c
diagnostics lib/obj/a.c
shutdown
exit
